hero.description: Strategy, bluff and betrayal… Will you survive the night?

whyUs.title: Werewolf, reimagined.
whyUs.subtitle: No app to download, no mandatory account. Just a link and your friends.

0.title: Game Master mode
0.body: One player becomes the narrator. Scripts guide each phase—dawn, twists, dramatic deaths. Perfect for setting the mood when you're all in the same room.

1.title: Start a game in 30 seconds
1.body: One code, one shared link, and you're off. No install, no account required to join a game.

2.title: Roles & variants
2.body: Dozens of roles, customizable setups. Every game is different.

3.title: 100% online
3.body: Play with friends remotely on video or just with the built-in chat. Distance is no excuse.

4.title: Completely free
4.body: No subscription, no microtransactions. GarOloup is and will stay free for everyone.

5.title: Always evolving
5.body: New roles, new mechanics, regular fixes. The community shapes development.

rules.title: One night, one life.
rules.subtitle: A game runs in Night / Day cycles until one side wins.

0.title: Night falls
0.body: Everyone closes their eyes. Werewolves pick a victim in silence. Special roles act in turn.

1.title: Dawn breaks
1.body: The night's victim is revealed. The Game Master narrates events and sets the tone.

2.title: The debate
2.body: Villagers debate, accuse, defend. Each player has limited time to speak and convince others.

3.title: The vote
3.body: The village votes to eliminate a suspect. The player with the most votes is out and their role is revealed.

roles.title: Who hides in the night?
roles.subtitle: Every role changes the game. Bluff, alliance, or betrayal—your move.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.description: Each night, the wolves choose a victim. By day, they blend in with the villagers.

witch.name: Witch
witch.description: Has two potions: one to save a wolf victim, one to eliminate any player.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: On death, they can take one last victim with them. A threat even in defeat.

gm.name: Game Master
gm.description: Doesn't play, but runs the game with narrated scripts. Ideal when everyone is in the same room.

fastJoin.title: Join the hunt.
fastJoin.subtitle: Open games are waiting. Slip into the village… or the pack.

players-min.question: How many players do you need at minimum?
players-min.answer: You need at least 6 players to start. Beyond 20, games get harder to run. The sweet spot is 8–12.

account.question: Do I need an account to play?
account.answer: No! Pick a nickname and join or create a game. An account saves your stats and favorite nicknames, but it's optional.

duration.question: How long does a game last?
duration.answer: About 15–45 minutes depending on player count and debate length set by the host. An 8-player game is usually around 20 minutes.

gm-mode.question: How does Game Master mode work?
gm-mode.answer: The Game Master is an out-of-game player who runs the session. They get narrated scripts each phase (night, dawn, death…) to keep immersion high. Great for in-person play!

irl.question: Can we play GarOloup in person?
irl.answer: Yes. GarOloup can replace the physical game: one shared screen or a phone per player is enough. Game Master mode fits this setup especially well.

evolutions.title: Shape GarOloup.
evolutions.subtitle: The game grows with you. A bug, an idea, a role to suggest—everything counts.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.body: Found something off? A crashy game, a role acting weird? Tell us—every report helps improve the experience for everyone.

idea.title: Suggest an idea
idea.body: New role in mind? A fun mechanic? A UI tweak? Share your ideas—the best ones make it into the game.

community.body: Want to follow progress, vote on upcoming features, and chat with other players?
